philosophy.notes: Matches the brief exactly: centered card, no split-screen, no illustration, no marketing copy. Developer-native posture — Manrope display, JetBrains Mono for IDs/labels, structured form chrome. Blue-led as DESIGN.md specifies (deep navy #1b4490 in light, sky #7cd0ff in dark). No purple/violet gradients. No emoji icons.

hierarchy.notes: Each screen has one obvious anchor (the primary action). Title → subtitle → form → submit → footer link. Visual weight is the blue submit button. Alerts sit above the form, never below — error/success can't be missed. On the launcher, the launcher grid cards are equal-weight so the user picks by title, not by visual bias.

execution.notes: Typography, spacing, alignment are consistent across all 6 files (Manrope + Inter + JetBrains Mono, 8/16/24/40 spacing scale, 8/12px radii). Subtitle of confirm-account reads in two places (subtitle line + 'Sending to' panel) which is intentional but could feel redundant. Mobile padding reduces to 22px and the OTP cells shrink to 52px at <420px — clean reflow. Minor: index.html launcher card #6 (SSO 'soon') sits at opacity 0.6 which can read as 'broken link' — could use clearer disabled styling.

specificity.notes: All copy is functional and concrete. Error messages name the fix: 'Enter a valid email address (e.g. you@company.com).' Strength meter says 'Weak / Fair / Strong / Excellent' not 'Stronger!'. Helper text says 'Use 8+ characters. Mix uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols for the strongest result.' — concrete advice, not platitudes. The launcher sub explains what Themis is in one sentence. No 'Feature One', no lorem ipsum, no fake metrics.

restraint.notes: Single accent (primary blue) used on brand mark, primary button, focus rings, links, active state, and a few selected backgrounds — all earn their place. One flourish per screen: balance-scale brand mark on chrome (consistent across all 6), password strength meter on sign-up/reset, OTP auto-advance on confirm. No competing gradients, no decorative imagery, no mascot. Dark mode flips without losing hierarchy.

would_improve: Replace the opacity-0.6 'SSO soon' card with a 'locked' badge or move it to a footer-level note so the launcher grid only shows actionable flows.

Confirm-account's email appears twice (subtitle inline + 'Sending to' panel). The 'Sending to' panel is the source of truth; the subtitle can drop the email and just say 'Enter the 6-digit code we sent.'
Sign-in.html includes a disabled 'Continue with SSO' button. Could be removed or labelled 'SSO coming soon' to make intent explicit.
